Hell Is Us is made to be found out on your own: no map, no compass, no quest markers. Keep as much of that as you want, and turn help on only where you get stuck. You can change your answers here any time.
Not answered yet: until you do, the mod adds nothing to the game.

Many players circle the first areas and are never sure what they missed. With this on: the minimap and big map, the compass, the route, your trail, pins and the quest tracker (the Map and Guide pages).
In return there is a map the game leaves out on purpose, and less of the tension of finding your own way.
Does what you missed bother you?

Players tell of finding an item hours later, or not knowing where the person was who wanted it. With this on: items, puzzles, people and doors on the maps, the places to go, and where the collectibles left and people with more to tell are.
It does the looking around for you. Off, the maps keep the land, the enemies and your own pins, and Collect shows counts only.
When you are stuck, would you like the answer?

Vault codes and dial puzzles hold players up for a long time, and seven achievements can be missed for good when a story beat passes. With this on: the Puzzles page (answers, vault codes, Lymbic locks), the deadlines of missable good deeds and the keystone order.
Answers still stay covered until you press for one, but deadlines and orders tell ahead where the story goes.
Are the fights or the grind wearing you down?

Some players tire of the same five Hollow Walker types and the fights again and again. With this on: the cheat groups in the sidebar (god mode, speed, resources and more), and the ones you keep turn back on next time.
They change the game’s values, so its difficulty and balance change. Achievements are not blocked. Turned off later, every cheat on goes back to its original value.
